title: GBPUSD M30 Fibonacci 38.2% Level Pruning (InpUseFib382=false) to Eliminate Low-Win-Rate Noise
research_question: Does disabling the 38.2% Fibonacci retracement level (InpUseFib382=false) eliminate low-conviction noise trades, raising overall 2026 UNSEEN win rate from 43.75% toward >50% while preserving 2020-2024 training profitability?
hypothesis: Because forensic deal analysis of EXP-0057 revealed that 38.2% retracements had only a 33.3% win rate and produced net losses (-$100.50), setting InpUseFib382=false will prune premature shallow entries during trend pauses. This isolates the higher-conviction 50.0% and 61.8% levels, improving the overall win rate and reducing drawdowns across both training and 2026 UNSEEN partitions.

facts: In EXP-0057 (2026 UNSEEN), trades at the 38.2% level achieved only a 33.3% win rate (1 win vs 2 losses, net -$100.50).
In EXP-0056 (5-Year Training), the 38.2% level produced 0 wins and 1 loss (0.0% win rate, net -$100.50).
The 50.0% level demonstrated strong performance in EXP-0057 with 9 wins out of 16 trades (56.2% win rate, net +$193.50), including 83.3% win rate on short trades.
inferences: The 38.2% Fibonacci level represents too shallow a retracement on M30, frequently triggering entries during minor pullbacks before the true structural swing correction completes.
Disabling InpUseFib382 will eliminate shallow stop-outs without degrading the primary trade generation at 50.0% and 61.8%.
evidence: EXP-0057 deal analysis: 382_B total=3, wins=1, losses=2, win_rate=33.3%, net=-100.50
EXP-0056 deal analysis: 382_B total=1, wins=0, losses=1, win_rate=0.0%, net=-100.50

independent_variables.name: InpUseFib382
independent_variables.rationale: Prunes shallow, low-conviction 38.2% retracement entries to focus capital on deeper, higher-probability levels.

assumptions: 50.0% and 61.8% levels will continue to trigger valid entries without 38.2% interference.
Removing 38.2% will slightly reduce overall trade count while improving win rate.
expected_observations: Overall win rate increases compared to EXP-0056 and EXP-0057.
Elimination of 38.2% losing trades saves ~$100 on both training and 2026 UNSEEN.
falsification_conditions: Win rate decreases or 2026 UNSEEN net loss deepens beyond -$433.13.
